children: reported a 142% rise in its annual profit on Thursday, supported by robust shipping volumes and divestment gains from the sale of the Mainland Group.
The world's biggest dairy exporter reported a profit after tax of NZ$2.61 billion ($1.47 billion) for the year, compared with NZ$1.08 billion a year earlier.
Fonterra recognized a NZ$1.25 billion divestment benefit during the year from the sale of the Mainland Group to French dairy major Lactalis.
Profit was also helped by robust performance at the dairy co-operative's Ingredients business, supported by strong protein demand and favorable pricing and product mix decisions.
Fonterra declared a final dividend of 33 New Zealand cents per share, lifting its total payout for the year to 73 NZ cents, higher than 57 NZ cents a year earlier.
